name: shadow_field.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (c Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Parent (mk-Parent (value Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Child (mk-Child (value Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Parent (sel-Parent Parent))
  (lift-Child (sel-Child Child))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Parent ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Parent (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Parent ((this Ref)) Parent
  (sel-Parent (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Child ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Child (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Child ((this Ref)) Child
  (sel-Child (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Parent ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-Parent this)
    (deref-is-Child this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Child ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Child this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.c: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!c ((this Ref)) Ref
  (c (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ----------------------------
;   Getters for class Child:
; ----------------------------

; --- getters for Child.value: ---

(define-fun Child.value ((this Ref)) Int
  (value (deref-Child this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Child (TopLevelDeclarations!c this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (Child.value (TopLevelDeclarations!c this)) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Child.value (TopLevelDeclarations!c this)) 42)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))



; -------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Parent:
; -------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Parent Parent)



; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Child:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-Child Child)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-Parent const-1-Parent))
        2 (lift-Child const-2-Child))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-2-Child () Child
  (mk-Child 42))
(define-fun const-1-Parent () Parent
  (mk-Parent 3))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (c (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (value (sel-Child a!1)) 42)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (c (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Child a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (c (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (> (value (sel-Child a!1)) 0)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2)))
                  1
                  (lift-Parent (mk-Parent 3)))))
  (store a!1 2 (lift-Child (mk-Child 42)))))
